test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is '**incompetent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**incompetent**'. • It means **'lacking the necessary skill to do something well'.** (जिसमें उच्‍च स्‍तर की कुशलता की कमी है; अक्षम, असमर्थ) • *Example: He is too **incompetent **to be trusted with such an important responsibility. * • The man was upset because the school principal, supervisor and teachers were unaware of their professional responsibilities and lacked the necessary skills that were required to execute their duties. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1**. Correct Paragraph:__* "During my first year of teaching, I was quite (1) __upset__ to find that the school principal, supervisor and teachers (2) __appeared__ to be unaware of their professional responsibilities and (3) **__incompetent__ **in executing their duties. For example, my principal's main (4) ________ were that all window shades be at the same (5) ________ , the classrooms be quiet and the rose beds should not be stepped upon."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Incorrigible**: (used about a person or his/her behaviour) very bad; too bad to be corrected or improved. [(व्‍यक्ति या उसका आचरण) बहुत ख़राब, असुधार्य] • **Incredible**: impossible or very difficult to believe. (जिस पर विश्‍वास करना असंभव या बहुत कठिन हो; अविश्‍वसनीय) • **Inconvenient**: causing trouble or difficulty, especially when it affects something that you need to do. [असुविधाजनक (विशेषतः आवश्‍यक काम में)] 4a:Tee9, Here the correct answer is **Concerns**.
